description:
An e-commerce company has a comprehensive order fulfillment process:
When a customer places an order, the system records the order details.
Payment processing begins.
If the payment fails, the customer is notified, and the process ends.
Upon successful payment, the inventory system checks stock availability.
If items are out of stock, a back-order is initiated, and the customer is informed about the delay.
The process continues once the back-order is received and all required items are available in stock.
In-stock items are picked from the warehouse.
Quality control checks are performed on the picked items.
Packaging is done, including gift wrapping if the customer requested it.
Meanwhile, the shipping department prepares shipping documents and labels.
If the order is international, customs documentation is prepared.
Once packaging and shipping documents are ready, the order is dispatched.
The system sends a shipping confirmation to the customer.
After dispatch, the system updates the inventory levels.
A follow-up email for feedback is sent directly after confirming the successful delivery.
If the customer reports any issues upon delivery, a returns process is initiated, which includes:
Sending a return shipping label.
Receiving returned items.
Inspecting returned items.
Processing a refund or replacement.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BackOrderReceived" name="Back-order received"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="E-commerce Company" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_01" name="Places order" messageRef="Msg_OrderPlaced" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_02" name="Payment failure notice" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_03" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_04" name="Shipping confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_05" name="Confirms successful delivery" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_06" name="Reports issue" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveIssueReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_07" name="Feedback email" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_08" name="Return shipping label" sourceRef="SubTask_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_09" name="Returned items sent" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="SubTask_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order Fulfillment" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderTrigger" name="Order trigger"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveCustomerOrder" name="Receive customer order"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order details"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ProcessPayment" name="Process payment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentCheck" name="Payment successful?" default="SF_06"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" name="Notify customer of payment failure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PaymentFailed" name="Order not fulfilled (payment failed)"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockCheck" name="Items in stock?" default="SF_10"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InitiateBackOrder" name="Initiate back-order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InformDelay" name="Inform customer of delay"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_BackOrderReceived" name="Back-order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_BackOrderReceived" messageRef="Msg_BackOrderReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock available"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick items from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_QualityControl" name="Perform quality control"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Start packaging and shipping preparation"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Package" name="Package order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrap_Split" name="Gift wrapping requested?" default="SF_21"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_GiftWrap" name="Gift wrap items"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GiftWrap_Merge" name="Packaging complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" name="Prepare shipping documents and labels"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International_Split" name="International order?" default="SF_26"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CustomsDocs" name="Prepare customs documentation"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_International_Merge" name="Shipping documents complete"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Ready_Join" name="Packaging and shipping documents ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Dispatch" name="Dispatch order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" name="Start shipment confirmation and inventory update"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" name="Send shipping confirmation to customer"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_UpdateInventory" name="Update inventory levels"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" name="Shipping confirmed and inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_Delivery" name="Delivery outcome"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDeliveryConfirmation" name="Receive successful delivery confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveIssueReport" name="Receive delivery issue report"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" name="Send feedback follow-up email"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_OrderCompleted" name="Order completed"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Returns" name="Returns process">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="SubStart_Returns" name="Return initiated"/>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="SubTask_SendReturnLabel" name="Send return shipping label"/>
      <bpmn:receiveTask id="SubTask_ReceiveReturnedItems" name="Receive returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="SubTask_InspectReturn" name="Inspect returned items"/>
      <bpmn:task id="SubTask_RefundOrReplace" name="Process refund or replacement"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="SubEnd_Returns" name="Return processed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SFR_01" sourceRef="SubStart_Returns" targetRef="SubTask_SendReturnLabel"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SFR_02" sourceRef="SubTask_SendReturnLabel" targetRef="SubTask_ReceiveReturnedItems"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SFR_03" sourceRef="SubTask_ReceiveReturnedItems" targetRef="SubTask_InspectReturn"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SFR_04" sourceRef="SubTask_InspectReturn" targetRef="SubTask_RefundOrReplace"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SFR_05" sourceRef="SubTask_RefundOrReplace" targetRef="SubEnd_Returns"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReturnHandled" name="Return handled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderTrigger" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_02" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCustomerOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_03" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_04" sourceRef="Task_ProcessPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_05" name="Payment failed" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentCheck" targetRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${paymentFailed == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_06" name="Payment successful" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentCheck" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_07" sourceRef="Task_NotifyPaymentFailure" targetRef="End_PaymentFailed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_08" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_09" name="Out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Task_InitiateBackOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${outOfStock == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_10" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockCheck" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_11" sourceRef="Task_InitiateBackOrder" targetRef="Task_InformDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_12" sourceRef="Task_InformDelay" targetRef="Catch_BackOrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_13" sourceRef="Catch_BackOrderReceived" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_14" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_15" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_QualityControl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_16" sourceRef="Task_QualityControl" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_17" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_Package"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_18" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_19" sourceRef="Task_Package" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrap_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_20" name="Gift wrap requested" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrap_Split" targetRef="Task_GiftWrap">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${giftWrapRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_21" name="No gift wrap" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrap_Split" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrap_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_22" sourceRef="Task_GiftWrap" targetRef="Gateway_GiftWrap_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_23" sourceRef="Gateway_GiftWrap_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_24" sourceRef="Task_PrepareShippingDocs" targetRef="Gateway_International_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_25" name="International" sourceRef="Gateway_International_Split" targetRef="Task_CustomsDocs">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${internationalOrder == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_26" name="Domestic" sourceRef="Gateway_International_Split" targetRef="Gateway_International_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_27" sourceRef="Task_CustomsDocs" targetRef="Gateway_International_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_28" sourceRef="Gateway_International_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Ready_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_29" sourceRef="Gateway_Ready_Join" targetRef="Task_Dispatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_30" sourceRef="Task_Dispatch" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_31" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_32" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Split" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_33" sourceRef="Task_SendShippingConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_34" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_35" sourceRef="Gateway_Dispatch_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_36" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDeliveryConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_37" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivery" targetRef="Task_ReceiveIssueReport"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_38" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDeliveryConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_39" sourceRef="Task_SendFeedbackEmail" targetRef="End_OrderCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_40" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveIssueReport" targetRef="SubProcess_Returns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_41" sourceRef="SubProcess_Returns" targetRef="End_ReturnHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
